points.title: Welcome to Margadeshaka
points.description:
Margadeshaka builds AI products that help you navigate life's decisions and master new skills.

We blend Vedic wisdom with cutting-edge AI to create tools that genuinely understand and support you.

points.title: Our Mission
points.description:
To create AI that guides and educates with depth and care.

Not scripted Q&A tools, but thoughtful companions that help you make better decisions and build real expertise.

We believe AI should amplify human potential, not replace human connection.

points.title: Sakha — Your AI Friend
points.description:
Sakha is the friend you turn to when things feel heavy or unclear.

Your personal AI companion for emotional clarity — offering personalized guidance on relationships, decisions, and everything in between, grounded in who you are.

Powered by advanced AI and precise astronomical calculations.

points.title: Sakha Features
points.description:
What Sakha offers:

• Evidence-based emotional coaching
• Daily check-ins & personal reflection
• Relationship guidance
• Crisis-aware support
• Available on Web, iOS, and Android

points.title: Dronacharya — Learn by Thinking
points.description:
Dronacharya transforms passive watching into active thinking.

Specialized AI tutors guide you through interactive lessons, adapt to your understanding, and help you build real projects for your portfolio.

Learn by thinking, not watching.

points.title: Dronacharya Features
points.description:
What Dronacharya offers:

• Fully interactive AI tutoring
• Adaptive difficulty & personalized teaching
• Bronze, Silver, and Gold certifications
• Progress tracking with achievements
• Team management for organizations

points.title: Our Approach
points.description:
We build with intention:

• Deep understanding over shallow responses
• Substance over hype
• Privacy-first, always
• Thoughtful, human-centered experiences

Every feature exists to genuinely help — not to hook, harvest, or monetize your attention.

points.title: Join the Journey
points.description:
Whether you're seeking clarity in life's decisions or mastering new skills, Margadeshaka is here to walk with you.

Explore Sakha at sakha.live
